about_the_game:
One day, war broke out in your homeland.
In this moment of crisis, the fate of your beloved country rests in your hands. A brutal conflict unfolds on the battlefield, and it is up to you to defend your nation. Every decision you make could change the course of this war. The future of your homeland is in your control.

Hope is a war simulation game that immerses you in the brutality and intensity of large-scale battles.
In this game, you must navigate massive AI battles, adapt to ever-changing strategies, and survive the horrors of combat.

Key Features:

  • Large-Scale AI Battles: Engage in massive battles with hundreds of soldiers fighting for survival. Strategy is key to gaining the upper hand.

  • Limb Dismemberment & Blood System: Experience the harshness of war with realistic limb dismemberment and blood effects that heighten the intensity of battle.

  • Physics-Driven Bullets: Bullets follow realistic trajectories, providing a challenging and immersive combat experience.

  • Diverse Weaponry: Equip yourself with a wide array of weapons, each suited for different tactics and combat scenarios.

  • Armor System: Strategically use armor to enhance your defense, tailoring your protection to the threats on the battlefield.

Upcoming Features:

  • Mod Support: Expand the game with custom content, allowing players to create and share new scenarios and experiences.

  • Vehicles (Helicopters and Tanks): Take control of powerful vehicles like helicopters and tanks, using them to dominate the battlefield and gain a tactical advantage.

Now, the fate of your country is in your hands. Will you rise to the challenge and protect your homeland in Hope?

content_descriptors.notes:
The game does not contain any sexual or nudity-related content.

It features violent combat with blood effects and dismemberment. However, there are no depictions of internal organs or excessive gore. Blood appears as dark red splatter during combat and may remain on walls or the environment.

Players can disable gore via a “Gore” checkbox in the game settings. When gore is disabled, dismemberment is turned off and blood effects are replaced with colorful, non-realistic visual effects (e.g. fireworks-style bursts).

The game also provides visual examples comparing the gore on/off setting for clarity.

name: Hope

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1650 / AMD RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 Ti / RTX 2060 / AMD RX 5600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

short_description: HOPE is a realistic FPS game that provides a combat experience. Choose your weapons and survive on the battlefield with ballistic physics and a body dismemberment system.
